title: EDGE Mint Nicotine Pouches
description: EDGE Mint nicotine pouches deliver a clear, refreshing Mint taste with gentle sweetness and a cool, tidy profile that remains balanced throughout use. Each pouch fits neatly under the lip and releases nicotine gradually without smoke, vapour or noticeable odour. Available in 6mg (Medium), 9mg (Strong) and 12mg (Extra Strong), each Slim can includes 20 pouches designed for easy, discreet enjoyment at any time. Developed by EDGE, one of the UK’s most established vape brands, this premium pouch collection carries the same focus on quality and flavour that defines the wider EDGE range. Explore more EDGE Nicotine Pouch flavours including Spearmint and Watermelon. Nicotine Ranges: Light - 3mg this is best for new users. Medium - 6mg this is best for regular users. Strong - 9mg this is suited for more experienced users Extra Strong - 12mg this is suited for more experienced users How to Use: Nicotine Pouches Please Note: Do not chew, suck or swallow the pouches.
